heroHeadline: Phone messages tie Paz's intelligence chief to real-time tracking of the Beller shooting
heroSubtitle: Investigators say chats recovered from Fernando Cerimedo's phone show a contact identified as intelligence chief Erik Correa González messaging in real time during the Aug. 17 attack on Nadia Beller — who now calls it a "state crime" and is demanding President Paz respond. The fallout compounds a rough week for Paz, who dismissed his censured Economy Minister on Aug. 21, while cocalero federations loyal to Evo Morales staged an armed vigil warning security forces off him and the government signaled it may revise its unpopular diesel-price decree.
